name: Summarize meeting transcripts with GPT-4o, Jira, Notion, Slack and Sheets

parameters.content:
## Meeting Recap - Reminder Scheduler (24h before due)

### How it works

This workflow ingests meeting transcripts from either a Fathom webhook or a new file in Google Drive, normalizes the text, and uses an LLM to extract structured meeting notes and action items. It enriches action items with roster data, resolves owners and relative due dates, creates Jira issues, and publishes a meeting recap page in Notion. It posts Slack recap/exception notifications, stores 24-hour-before reminder rows in Google Sheets, and runs an hourly scheduler to send due Slack reminders and mark them sent.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Fathom webhook URL or enable the Google Drive trigger for the transcript folder you want to monitor.
- Connect Google Drive credentials with access to download transcript files and, for DOCX inputs, create/delete temporary converted Google Docs.
- Set up OpenAI credentials and verify the extraction prompt/schema used by the LLM node matches the expected meeting-note structure.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and configure the roster sheet plus the reminders sheet used for appending, reading, and marking reminder rows.
- Configure Jira credentials, project, issue type, assignee mapping fields, and any required custom fields in the Jira preparation/create nodes.
- Configure Notion API access and the target database/page properties used by the Notion payload and page creation request.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the recap, unmatched-owner alert, and reminder destination channels or user mappings.
- Check the hourly schedule timezone and any reminder-enabled flags or constants used in the code nodes.

### Customization

Common customization points include the LLM extraction prompt, roster owner matching rules, relative-date handling, Jira field mapping, Notion page properties, Slack message templates, and the reminder lead time if you want something other than 24 hours before the due date.

## Drive transcript intake

Starts the alternate Google Drive path by detecting new transcript files, downloading them, and routing them by file type.

## Convert DOCX transcripts

Handles the DOCX branch by converting the file to a Google Doc, downloading it as text, extracting the converted content, and deleting the temporary document.

## Normalize transcript input

Collects transcript text from the webhook path and direct file extraction branches, then normalizes the input into a consistent record for AI processing.

## Extract structured notes

Uses the LLM to turn normalized transcript text into structured meeting notes, then parses the model output for downstream processing.

## Resolve action details

Looks up the roster, attaches it to the extracted record, resolves action item owners, and converts relative due dates into concrete dates.

## Create Jira issues

Splits the resolved action items, prepares Jira fields, creates issues, merges each Jira result back with its action item, and recombines the enriched meeting record.

## Create Notion recap

Builds the Notion payload, creates the meeting recap page through the Notion API, and merges the Notion result back with the full meeting record.

## Post Slack recap

Posts the final meeting recap to Slack after the Notion page and meeting record have been merged.

## Alert unmatched owners

Checks whether any action item owners could not be matched to the roster and sends a Slack alert when needed.

## Store reminder rows

When reminders are enabled, computes reminder schedule rows for action items and appends them to the reminders sheet.

## Read scheduled reminders

Runs on an hourly schedule and reads the reminder rows from Google Sheets for evaluation.

## Send due reminders

Filters reminder rows that are due, sends the Slack reminder messages, and marks the corresponding sheet rows as sent.

' + '*Summary:*

') + '

' + 'Full notes: ' + $json.url }}

messages.content:
You are a meeting-notes extraction engine. Given a raw meeting transcript, an attendee list, and the meeting title, return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown fences, no commentary) matching exactly this shape:
{
  "summary": ["bullet 1", "bullet 2", "bullet 3"],
  "decisions": ["decision statement", ...],
  "action_items": [{"task": "string", "owner": "spoken first name as said in transcript", "due_date": "verbatim phrase as spoken, e.g. 'next Friday' or 'March 5' - do NOT resolve it yourself", "priority": "high|medium|low"}],
  "open_questions": ["string", ...],
  "risks": ["string", ...]
}
Rules: keep summary to exactly 3 bullets. Use the owner's first name exactly as spoken (do not guess a full name). Leave due_date as the verbatim spoken phrase; a downstream step resolves it. If no due date was mentioned, use null. If a field has no items, return an empty array.
